verdict.rationale: n8n has a dedicated core Webhook trigger node with its own docs page (n8n-docs-21). A production user independently confirms building a backend with "webhook-initiated tasks" (n8n-comm-18), which corroborates that external HTTP requests can start workflow runs. Missing for 10: documented detail on custom URL/path configuration, how the request payload reaches the workflow, and HTTP method/auth/response options — the docs evidence is only a page title.
